contact.basis: Fixed historical east main-entry approach outside the traced terrace/porch, before raw modern terrain/geometry. Modern school grading and old foundations/threshold remain unverified. No terrain fitting or full-site platform.

verticalDatum: Public Terrarium composite source heights; provider-relative host visualization, not a surveyed local datum.
attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
method: Original Terrarium RGB24 bytes bilinearly sampled at pixel centres in native historical Ambassador Hotel plot/street frame. Independent field frozen before any model geometry, without flattening or fitting.
limitations: Terrarium zoom15 output pixels may oversample much coarser native DEM.1m review grid and RGB encoding are not survey accuracy.

Composite urban heights may include/interpolate structure and vegetation; historical street/threshold/foundation versus current campus grading classification is unspecified. Compatible host field required; default coarse terrain is not automatically certified.
